requirement: Inventario search matches SKU, name, variant, external reference and the linked publication's title, brand and model
expected: Every word must appear in any order, ignoring accents and case; another store's data never matches.
preconditions: Inventory enabled; a SKU linked to a Boss DS-1 publication with a barcode as external reference.

requirement: The table follows the search box as the owner types
expected: After a short pause the table shows the matches without pressing Buscar; Back returns to the previous search, not to every letter.
steps: Type a word letter by letter, wait, then press Back.

requirement: The En revisión tile opens exactly what it counts; rejected publications have their own tile
expected: Pressing En revisión shows new publications and publications with changes in review; Rechazadas appears only when there are some and opens them.
preconditions: One pending publication, one approved with a pending change, one rejected.
steps: Press each tile and compare counts.

requirement: Inventario promises no catalog matching that does not exist
expected: No Catálogo filter; an old catalogo= link shows every SKU; the SKU page mentions the catalog only for a linked SKU.
steps: Open Filtrar; open /mi-cuenta/tienda/inventario?catalogo=matched; open an unlinked SKU.
